text: 中国央行连续23个月增持、全球89%央行仍要加仓！近日贵金属价格却持续走低，黄金真正害怕什么？央行购金到底能起到多大缓冲作用？一图查看。
text_en: The PBOC has increased its holdings for 23 consecutive months, and 89% of central banks worldwide still plan to add to positions! Yet precious metal prices have recently continued to decline. What is gold really afraid of? How much of a buffer can central bank gold purchases actually provide? See the chart.
